purpose: Teach: 珪/聾/鞍/烏/瑤/螢/禄/鄭

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、珪素、つまり珪チップの密輸事案を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: So the police are investigating this case involving silicon chips—the smuggling operation, correct?
lines.style: Steady, methodical opening. Respectful curiosity in the voice. Ren is processing information aloud, not challenging. Slight pause before the dash—clarification, not interruption.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、聾、つまり聴覚障害者の被害者保護も丁寧にされますね
lines.en: And the police are also being careful to protect the witnesses involved, including those with hearing impairments—that's part of the care here, isn't it?
lines.style: Measured agreement. Professional but warm. Officer Takeda nods along with the point being made. Even pace, affirming tone. Not defensive, just confirming procedure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現場の鞍、つまり馬の鞍の盗難を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: In this case, the theft of the saddle from the scene—the horse saddle—the police are investigating that as well, yes?
lines.style: Deliberate, almost methodical. Ren carefully restates the detail as if he's following procedure himself. No rush. Respectful attention to the specific object.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯行現場の烏、つまりカラスの目撃情報も参考にされますね
lines.en: And the police are looking into witness accounts from the scene—like sightings of crows—that information is being considered in the investigation, isn't it?
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Officer Takeda keeps pace without condescension. The oddness of crow witnesses doesn't register as strange to him—it's evidence. Calm, procedural.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、旧字「瑤」、つまり瑤の人名の戸籍を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: Regarding the old character form in the name records—you're saying the police are checking the registry documents for the person named Yō, correct?
lines.style: Ren returns to formal mode. Precise, respectful. He's drilling down into detail. Quiet concentration. Each phrase deliberate, as if reading from careful notes.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧字「螢」、つまり蛍の生息地の文化財保護も支援されますね
lines.en: And the police are also supporting the protection of cultural heritage sites—the habitat where fireflies are found, marked with that old character—that protection is being coordinated as well?
lines.style: Officer Takeda's voice stays even and supportive. He's following Ren into this widening circle of details without losing composure. Professional generosity in how he affirms each point.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、江戸期の禄、つまり俸禄文書の盗難を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: In this matter, there's also the theft of stipend documents from the Edo period—the salary records—the police are investigating that incident too, aren't they?
lines.style: Ren's voice takes on slight weight here. Historical documents add gravity. He speaks with the precision of someone handling fragile items with words. Careful, respectful pacing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、参考人鄭氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: And the police will be questioning the reference witness—the person named Zheng—to gather more details about what happened, I assume?
lines.style: Officer Takeda's tone closes with finality and warmth. He's bringing the investigation into focus. Warm but controlled. A slight lean-in—this is where the real picture emerges.
